text:
maria: Heads-up — platform team wants to rename a few console/telemetry headers to align with routing policy changes. This will touch SDKs that parse headers (Python/TS/Go). Need a compatibility plan.
ben: which headers exactly?
maria: here's the mapping we're proposing:
```
# old -> new
x-rw-routing -> x-rw-route
x-rw-quota -> x-rw-quota-id
x-rw-telemetry -> x-rw-telemetry-v2
```
julia: breaking names sucks but if we add fallbacks maybe we can avoid major bumps for most SDKs.
akash: fyi Go client is already slated for a major bump next quarter for the auth refactor, so we could fold the change there.
emma: Python can do a soft-fallback: prefer new headers, fall back to old, and emit a one-time DeprecationWarning. No major version needed.
ben: TS client has centralized header parsing at src/http/headers.ts — we can add tolerant parsing there. Example quick patch: 
```ts
export function getRoutingHeader(headers: Record<string,string>) {
  return headers['x-rw-route'] || headers['x-rw-routing'];
}
```
maria: good. Two additional constraints: 1) telemetry payload shape for x-rw-telemetry-v2 is structured (fields) instead of freeform blob, and 2) console should show a deprecation banner and send a deprecate header to older clients during rollout.
rory: we should plan 3-month deprecation window and emit a header like `x-rw-deprecated-headers: yes` when old keys are used so we can count clients.
emma: +1 on counting. For Python I'll add a telemetry parser that accepts both blob and structured, with a flag to opt-in to strict v2 parsing.
julia: who will own SDK release notes and migration guides? we need snippets for all three languages and a small section in Console -> Observability docs.
ben: I'll open PR in TS SDK with the tolerant parser and a test matrix for old/new headers. assign to @ben and @akash for review.
akash: will add Go compatibility in the major bump branch and include a migration note.
release-bot: NOTE: planned header rename deploy window: 2026-06-10 -> 2026-06-17. Please coordinate SDK patches before 2026-06-08.
maria: plan summary: 1) SDKs add tolerant parsing + deprecation warning or metric, 2) Console shows deprecation banner + telemetry counts, 3) Platform emits `x-rw-deprecated-headers` for counting, 4) Go does major bump, Python/TS aim for minor/patch with fallback. Target: SDK PRs open by 1766260000 and released before release-bot window.
rory: also add an opt-in strict mode env var for customers who want strict v2 behavior during canary.
ben: ok I'll include `RW_STRICT_TELEMETRY=true` env var in TS.
maria: can someone volunteer to draft the migration doc? one page with examples for each SDK and a code snippet for parsing fallback.
emma: I'll draft Python + migration examples.
julia: I'll handle Console copy + banner design.
akash: I'll coordinate Go changes with eng-runtime since we need to ensure kernel telemetry tags are compatible.
ben: pinging @eng-platform for a quick schema doc link? otherwise I'll mock a sample payload.
maria: thanks — I'll track in the tracking ticket and set a reminder. Any objections? :thumbsup:
ben: :thumbsup:
julia: :thumbsup:
emma: :thumbsup:
akash: :thumbsup:
rory: no objections
release-bot: reminder scheduled for 1766260000 to reopen thread if SDK PRs not merged.
